preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of the string t must be between 1 and n.
The maximum number of pieces x must be between 1 and 30.
The lengths of the strings s and t must match the provided lengths n and m.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t must consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if f(s, t) <= x else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'YES' if the minimal number of substrings f(s, t) is less than or equal to x, otherwise 'NO'.
